description: Tractor Supply Company is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the United States, focused on supplying the needs of recreational farmers, ranchers, and all those who enjoy living the rural lifestyle, which it refers to as the Out Here lifestyle, and it operates retail stores under the names Tractor Supply Company and Petsense by Tractor Supply, with stores located primarily in towns outlying major metropolitan markets and in rural communities, and also offers an expanded assortment of products through the Tractor Supply mobile application and online at TractorSupply.com, Petsense.com and Allivet.com. On December 30, 2024 it completed its acquisition of Allivet, an online pet pharmacy, acquiring 100 percent of the equity interest for a purchase price of $135.0 million, financed with cash on hand from the balance sheet, and the Company has one reportable industry segment which is the retail of pet products, pet food, hardware, automotive maintenance, outdoor, and seasonal merchandise.
